title: FM deviation and bandwidth
idea: FM's width comes from how far it swings plus how fast. Multiplier stages multiply the deviation along with the frequency.

lines: A multiplier stage makes a harmonic to reach the final frequency
It multiplies the deviation by the same number
So oscillator deviation = final deviation / multiplier

compare.how: How far the carrier swings from center. Sets most of the width.
How fast it swings. Sidebands appear that far apart.
Multiplies frequency and deviation by the same whole number.

traps.why: That's deviation + audio once. Carson doubles it: 2 x 8 = 16 kHz.
That multiplies by 12. The oscillator comes before the multiplier, so divide: 5 kHz / 12 = 416.7 Hz.
A mixer makes sums and differences. Making a harmonic is a multiplier's job.
